senses.gloss: Ādeśakārin (EI 10), an officer or agent, or a representative.
Ādeśa-naibandhika (EI 7; CII 4), official designation indicating the recorder of orders.
ādeya (EI 7, 12, 15; CII 3), ‘what is to be taken or levied’; a fiscal term meaning the same thing as ādāya, i. e. income or impost; dues (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXV, p. 237).
